verdict.rationale: Recurring scheduling is a fair question for a hosting and serverless platform like Netlify, so the axis applies. The pack contains no evidence of scheduled or cron functions or any recurring job trigger. Serverless functions, the REST API for automating workflows, and auto-deploy on push are event-triggered features or building blocks, not a recurring schedule, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can schedule recurring jobs or workflows
